Class ConnectedFolders

java.lang.Object
com.mobybank.harness.domain.ConnectedFolders
public class ConnectedFolders extends Object
The document folders one analyst has connected, in the order they were connected. Folders are referenced by id only; their details come from the DocumentCatalog.
